svg.text: JDK, JRE, JVM: How It Works (Source Code to Output)
A complete package for Java development. It
contains the JRE plus development tools.
Provides the environment to run Java
applications: the JVM plus core libraries.
Since Java 9 there is no separate JRE download. Use
jlink to build a custom runtime.
The heart of Java. It executes bytecode and makes
Loads .class files, then links and initializes them
Checks bytecode for safety and correctness (linking)
Interpreter plus JIT compiler run the bytecode
Automatically frees unreachable objects on the heap
Android (Java/Kotlin, runs on ART, not a JVM)
Big data, cloud, embedded (e.g., Kafka, Hadoop)
The same bytecode runs on different operating
systems because a JVM exists for every major
